title: HyperDAG RepID Trust Receipt v1.0
description: Off-chain receipt format produced by repid-engine and committed/revealed via HyperDAGReceiptAdapter on Base Sepolia. Binds an ERC-8004 agentId to an x402 payment hash, the task/result that was paid for, the HAL constitutional output, and a RepID commitment. v1.0 ships commitment-only privacy; v1.1 adds selective disclosure; v2 adds full ZK.

receiptId.description: keccak256 of the canonical receipt-reveal params + reveal block.timestamp; assigned by HyperDAGReceiptAdapter.revealReceipt.

agentRegistry.description: ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry contract address. Base Sepolia canonical: 0x8004A818BFB912233c491871b3d84c89A494BD9e

agentWallet.description: Address that owns agentId at the time of receipt reveal (per IdentityRegistry.ownerOf)

paymentHash.description: keccak256 of canonical-JSON x402 payment payload

resourceHash.description: keccak256 of the resource URI being paid for

artifactHash.description: Optional hash of large artifact stored externally (e.g. file/IPFS)

repIdCommitment.description: Pedersen-style commitment to the agent's RepID at receipt time. v1.0 may use keccak256(repid || nonce); v1.1 swaps in Pedersen.

humanIdentityRoot.description: Reserved for v1.1 (ERC-7231). bytes32(0) / null in v1.0.

hal.description: HAL constitutional-audit output. Mandatory in v1.0 — this is the patent moat. Bound from the existing /hal/signals pipeline output in repid-engine.

boundedScore.description: HAL combiner output (already × Pythagorean Comma). Range [0, 1.014].

commaBftVerdict.description: Pythagorean Comma BFT (P-003). 'veto' = critical severity hard constitutional block. 'indeterminate' = fewer than 3 providers responded.

dimensionsHash.description: keccak256 of canonical-JSON of HAL dimension breakdown (harm/epistemic/evidence/scope/certainty/agreement)

outputHash.description: keccak256 of full HAL output JSON (signals + score + veto fields + formula string)

pythagoreanCommaConstant.description: Documents the multiplier used. Constant — included for self-describing receipts.

validators.description: Attestors. v1.0 requires the primary attestor (typically 'self' or 'zk-stub'). Secondary attestors are recorded but not enforced on-chain in v1.0; v1.1 adds Trinity BFT validators (per Gemini parallel sprint).

signature.description: EIP-191 / EIP-1271 signature over attestationHash by the validator's address

score.description: RepID at receipt time (committed in identity.repIdCommitment, exposed here for off-chain consumers when privacy.mode = 'commitment-only' is being relaxed for known consumers)

formulaVersion.description: Semver/tag of the RepID formula in use, e.g. 'repid-2026-04-17'

mode.description: v1.0 ships only 'commitment-only'. 'selective-disclosure' is v1.1, 'full-zk' is v2.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC of receipt issuance (off-chain). On-chain createdAt is block.timestamp at reveal.
